news.title: Floating Compass v1.1.1 Released
news.content: Maintenance update: Qt6 compatibility improvements for QGIS 4, plus an informational news panel.

news.title: Floating Compass Pro
news.content: Advanced features for RF planning and GIS workflows are available in Floating Compass Pro, including multi-arm mode, beam profiles, HUD with live ISG, and ruler mode.

news.title: Related QGIS Tools
news.content: Additional QGIS plugins by the same author are available, including Equidistant Site Center for balanced site placement.
